A-8973

SUBSTITUTE ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RT-4,
Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 11-G in the area bound by:

a line 84.12 feet north of West Sunnyside Avenue; the alley next east of West Kenmore
Avenue; West Sunnyside Avenue; and North Kenmore Avenue,

to those of a B3-5, Community Shopping District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Angela Clay
Alderperson, 46'" Ward

Common Address:
1020 W. Sunnyside Avenue
